title: chough migrate leaves session.v1.json, pruned.jsonl and the .chough/artifacts files out of its accounting
symptom: The migration preview of this repository lists neither .chough/session.v1.json nor any of the 643 tracked files under .chough/artifacts/ anywhere in the plan, and lists .chough/pruned.jsonl as unaccounted with no mapper removing it
trigger: Build the 0.6.0 branch and run chough migrate (preview only) on a fresh clone of this repository
expected: Every 0.5.x file REQ-records-009 removes is in the plan's sources and is carried, removed with why, kept as an open bug's fixture, or reported as unaccounted so the apply refuses
actual: session.v1.json and the artifacts are absent from sources, removed and unaccounted, so an apply would leave them in the migrated tree silently; pruned.jsonl is unaccounted
steps: Clone the repository at the branch head into a scratch folder
Build it and run chough migrate
Compare the plan's sources, removed and unaccounted with every file Git tracks under .chough/
impact: A migrated tree would keep 0.5.x files the requirement removes, and a file a mapper misses under .chough/artifacts/ would never show as unaccounted
source: t37j's read-only migration preview rehearsal (plan Migration step 2) at 5c47bc7b, plan digest 79d47efd

notes.text: Red on the current framework: TC-records-migrate-accounts-every-file fails at the plan's sources assertion (session.v1.json absent), revision 398a73da on leif/0.6.0-migrate-accounting-red.
